topics.titleTr: Siradaki Ise Alimin Bir Agent Olabilir: Karar Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Your Next Hire Might Be an Agent: A Decision Guide
topics.keywordTr: insan mi yapay zeka agent mi
topics.angle: decision guide for lean founders choosing between a hire and an agent
topics.brief: Outline: the 'team of three doing the work of ten' claim and where it holds; a decision framework (judgment, accountability, volume, risk, repeatability); tasks agents own well vs human-only work; the hidden costs of agents (oversight, error handling, tooling, drift); a staffing matrix; when you should still hire a person. Verify the lean-team/AI-agent productivity claims. Sources: https://waveup.com/blog/top-19-ai-tools-for-startups-and-small-businesses/ and https://blog.mean.ceo/bootstrapping-startup-trends-october-2026/.

topics.titleTr: Regule Alicilara Yapay Zeka Satmak: Kurucu Rehberi
topics.titleEn: Selling AI to Regulated Buyers: A Founder's Primer
topics.angle: guide: compliance, procurement and trust for B2G and regulated B2B
topics.brief: Outline: why regulated buyers (government, health, finance) are opening to AI now (e.g., FedRAMP High via Claude for Government); what they demand (audit logs, data residency, spend controls, human-in-the-loop, SOC 2); navigating long procurement cycles; how a small vendor positions on trust; building on a compliant platform vs reselling. Verify the Claude for Government FedRAMP High launch and its governance features. Sources: https://www.anthropic.com/news and https://www.infoq.com/articles/cloud-devops-trends-2026/ (sovereignty/compliance).
